comparison.objective: Orient floor exit arrows at aisle junctions toward the nearest exits by walking route; candidate adjusts a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Route selection, walking-distance reasoning, and arrow placement differ from bimanual mechanical adjustment, tool insertion, and force-limited fastening.
comparison.success_condition: Arrows must point toward nearest exits by route; the record omits angular, placement, and route-equivalence tolerances. Candidate uses quantified physical impact checks.
comparison.reason: This tests navigation-based signage placement, not machinery maintenance.
